name: Moody's Film Lab
dropBoxes: Porchlight Coffee & Records — 1517 14th Ave, Capitol Hill
Sonic Boom Records — 2209 NW Market St, Ballard
Bulldog News & Cafe — 4208 University Way NE, U-District
C&P Coffee — 5612 California Ave SW, West Seattle
Leica Store — 11111 NE 8th St Suite 130, Bellevue
notes: Drop your roll where you buy records or coffee. $17/roll develop + scan, $23 for E-6; negatives held two months, or $7 to mail them back.

name: We Develop Film (Photo HQ)
notes: Fast, friendly counter that often turns scans around next day. Prints, archiving and passport photos too.

name: Panda Lab
notes: Long-running pro lab with archival darkroom printing and heirloom scanning. Mail-in is by arrangement only, so call before you ship.

name: Shy Film Lab
dropBoxes: Retropolitan Vintage Mall — 234 SW Broadway, Portland
notes: The lab arm of Shy Film Club, for photographers who would rather skip the big photowalk. Develop-only from $8, develop + scan from $20. No E-6.

name: Ambient Film Lab
dropOff: 40080 SW Nelson Dr, Gaston — drop box only
dropBoxes: Chapters Books & Coffee — 701 E 1st St, Newberg
turnaround: Newberg box is emptied Tuesday mornings
notes: Small lab south-west of Portland, open since autumn 2025. Order and pay online first, then mail in or use a drop box; returns ship at your cost.

name: The Darkroom
notes: Mail-only, with a free prepaid mailer. From $14/roll develop + scan, $11 develop-only; E-6 and odd formats +$6. No ECN-2.

name: Speedy's 1-Hour Photo
notes: The closest quick color turnaround in town. Tues-Sat; call ahead for anything other than C-41 35mm.

name: Tacoma Photo Center
notes: Nonprofit community darkroom. Have them process it, or book the darkroom and do it yourself. Open Thu-Sun 1-8pm; nothing new starts after 7.

name: Creativeroom Film Lab
dropBoxes: The Showroom — 70 N Colville St, Walla Walla
turnaround: 3-7 business days once your rolls are logged in
notes: Mail-in from our end, developed and scanned on Noritsu gear. From $15/roll for 35mm color; 4K scans, prints and negatives back cost extra. No E-6 or 120.
